before: Long inputs at modest cost: the authors report pretraining on inputs up to 200 kb on one 32 GB V100, and pretraining took 60 hours on four RTX 3090 GPUs.
after: Long inputs at modest cost: in a memory test the authors report the architecture could fit inputs up to 200 kb on one 32 GB V100, although the model itself was pretrained on 20 kb windows. Pretraining took 60 hours on four RTX 3090 GPUs.
why: The 200 kb figure comes from a time and memory comparison during long-sequence pretraining; the paper says the model was pretrained on 20 kb windows. Added quotes for both passages.
